AePS · selected bank is in outage

Clickable rebuild of what the adhikari sees in the Spice Money app (v6.6.62) when the customer's bank is down: AePS screen → pick a bank (from the 5 quick picks or View All) → the app checks the bank with outage/info/app → the "{Bank} is facing issues" popup with Try Later / Continue Anyway. Layouts, colours, fonts and fixed copy come from the app. The popup's body text is sent by the server, so here it is editable; the outage message, bank IINs and agent details are made up.

NewAepsRevampFragment · AEPSBankSelectionActivity
layout rekyc_dialog · POST …/aeps/rbl/outage/info/app
responses simulated · no real network calls

Scenario

The app asks the server about each bank only when the adhikari picks it.
Real wording is set in Spice's backend; this sample is invented.
Tip: tap Cash Withdraw on home, then tap SBI in the quick picks, or View All → State Bank of India.

Exact copy in the app

Title: bankName + " is facing issues"
Body: responseMessage (from server)
Button: "Try Later" → closes the popup, bank not selected
Link: "Continue Anyway" → bank is selected anyway
Icon: @drawable/exclamation_triangle; not cancellable
Null response: "Error" / "Something went wrong. Please try again." / OK
1 Home2 AePS3 Select bank4 Outage popup5 Bank selected
The popup appears on the AePS screen (quick picks) or on the bank list (View All).
